claims.claim: Missing service information causes independent repair shops to incur labor time that they cannot honestly bill to customers.
When repair information is missing, independent technicians search for information, perform additional disassembly and testing, guess at procedures, and sometimes send jobs elsewhere.
Restricted repair information causes customers to lose time.
Restricted repair information reduces the productive capacity of independent repair shops.
Restricted repair information gives authorized repair channels greater leverage.
The burdens caused by missing service information constitute concrete overhead for independent repair shops.
After a shop purchases access to one manufacturer's service portal, repairing another brand may require a separate fee, login, tool, or approval.
Each service-information access gate consumes independent-shop time and gives the party controlling access authority over the repair conditions.
Independent repair shops pay access costs before they can determine whether a repair can be completed.
Documentation restrictions and parts-pairing restrictions are two mechanisms of the same form of repair control.
Parts-paired devices can reject or impair the operation of a replacement component that is physically correct and electrically sound.
Independent repair shops incur subscription costs because of restricted repair access.
Restricted repair access causes independent shops to have idle service bays.
Restricted repair access increases training time for independent shops.
Restricted repair access requires independent shops to acquire duplicated equipment.
Restricted repair access causes independent shops to turn away work.
Restricted repair access delays customers' repairs.
Restricted repair access reduces customers' repair choices.
Restricted repair access causes equipment to be discarded before the end of its useful life.
Restricted repair access increases material waste borne by the public.
Restrictions that impose the described repair costs are justified as protection for intellectual property.
Control over repair information enables information owners to control how other people use or repair their physical property.
